methodology: Screened Qur'an 7:26–30 against explicit translation; checked Genesis 3:7,21 in NET translation and Genesis 3:1–24 as a proposed related account. No primary-language textual collation, critical edition, manuscript witness assessment or historical-dependence proof completed. Source locators are research candidates, not public verified links.

records.theme: Clothing conceals nakedness; righteousness as figurative garment

candidates.difference: Genesis describes fig-leaf coverings made by humans and garments of skin made by God; Qur'an 7:26 addresses descendants of Adam and calls righteousness the superior garment.

records.theme: Warning against Satan; parents' exposure and expulsion

candidates.difference: Genesis portrays a serpent and the couple's awareness of nakedness, but does not explicitly identify the serpent as Satan or describe Satan stripping their garments.

records.theme: Ancestral custom invoked to justify shameful conduct
records.note: No specific earlier passage established in this screening; possible wider anti-idolatry polemics require source-specific investigation.

records.theme: Justice, sincere worship and return to life
records.note: Generic ethical and resurrection motifs are insufficient for a claimed textual parallel; seek a specific distinctive source before association.

records.theme: Guidance, error and demons as patrons
records.note: No source-specific pre-Islamic parallel established by this preliminary pass; not a claim that no parallel exists.
